newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hamas calls for total confrontations with Israel.
newsitem.headline: Hamas calls for total confrontations with Israel.

text.p: The Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas on Thursday urged Palestinians to head to "total confrontations" with Israeli forces and settlers after Friday prayers.

"Hamas Movement calls our heroic people to come out after Friday prayers tomorrow in marches and total confrontations against the forces of the Zionist occupation and its herds of settlers," the group said in a statement faxed to an international news agency in Beirut.

Hamas said its call for confrontation was "to express the continuation of the Aqsa intifada as long as the threat to the holy Aqsa mosque remains by keeping the sinister tunnel open and so long as the crimes of Judaisation and settlement continue."

The call came a day after a two-day Israeli-Palestinian summit at the White House to discuss ways to end violence that has killed 73 Arabs and Jews in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank. The violence was touched off last week by Israel's opening of an entrance to an archaeological tunnel in Jerusalem.

The Washington summit, called by U.S. President Bill Clinton, grouped Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Jordan's King Hussein and produced no agreement on major outstanding issues.
